title: Minswap + Fluid Tokens: a “smart token” DEX on Cardano

ms.promise: A functional AMM v2.1 contract capable of supporting programmable token-like assets, adhering to the standards outlined in CIP113.
ms.criteria:
・The DEX can list and facilitate trading of programmable token-like assets.
・The AMM v2.1 contract correctly handles the lifecycle and interactions of these assets.
・The DEX integrates seamlessly with the existing Cardano infrastructure and wallets.

FRONTEND IS NOT READY YET AND NOT SCOPE OF THIS MILESTONE, THE TRANSACTIONS WERE SUBMITTED USING COMMAND LINE, THAT'S WHY THEY DO NOT APPEAR IN THE DEMO VIDEO
・Demo video using command line link

The contract is a fork of the current amm dex v2 that can be found here however the contract enforces that tokens can only be traded across CIP113 owners
This milestone was needed in order to generate the code for tokens cip113 in aiken and also to change the dex logic, the contract is already compatible with current cardano infrastructure and wallets because it's written in aiken and is a fork of a project already running in mainnet
The following milestone will connect the contracts and add more features, in milestone 3 we will also start the frontend part

ms.promise: Separate additional parts of the "main" DEX smart contract (delivered in the first milestone) for the CIP113 tokens (such as where are the tokens sent from the DEX? to this contract to store them for the user) that is necessary for the solution
ms.criteria:
- The additional smart contracts adhere to the CIP113 standards and best practices. 
- The contracts are internally tested and audited for security and functionality. 
- Integration with the DEX (the main DEX smart contract built in the first milestone) and other components is seamless.
